text:
Mia: Heads-up — I'm rolling out the micro-profiling telemetry for GPU serving this week. Goal: token-level latency + SM occupancy + VRAM deltas sampled at request boundaries. Will be opt-in per route at first.
Raj: Nice. What's the measured overhead at 1% sampling? worried about added latency.
Mia: Good question. Synthetic baseline shows ~0.6% tail impact (p95 token latency) at 1% sampling with async collector. CPU overhead ~15ms/sample but it's offloaded to the telemetry worker. Real workloads look lower.
Olivia: Can we see the raw numbers? also want per-route KPIs (latency, cost-per-token, occupancy) exposed for ops dashboards.
PerfBot: Automated run uploaded: https://perf.redwood/internal/runs/2026-03-14/telemetry-sm-sample-1pct (summary: p50 18ms, p95 98ms, sampling overhead measured 0.9% on p95)
Mia: TL;DR: try 0.5% on high-traffic routes, 1% on experimental/low-QPS routes. We keep token-level traces for 1k tokens or 200ms, whichever comes first.
Raj: How do we configure opt-in? feature flag or route config?
Mia: Route config. Example snippet:
routes:
  - name: chat-stream
    telemetry:
      micro_profile: true
      sample_rate: 0.005 # 0.5%
      capture_tokens: 1000
Olivia: For dashboards I'd like:
- token-latency waterfall per model-version
- SM occupancy heatmap by (model, batch_size, seq_len)
- VRAM delta per request id (7s sliding)
- MIG slice contention gauge
Raj: For the SM occupancy heatmap what dimension keys do we emit? batch_size and op_type?
Mia: We'll emit: model_name, model_version, route, batch_size, seq_len_bucket, kernel_variant, op_type (forward/kv/cache), sm_occupancy_pct, vram_bytes, gpu_power_w, gpu_temp_c, mig_slice_id.
Alex: I'll draft Grafana panels. Example PromQL for SM occupancy 95th over 5m:
quantile_over_time(0.95, gpu_sm_occupancy_percent{model=~".*bert.*"}[5m])
Alex: For VRAM delta time series use rate of vram_bytes emitted per request_id and then sum by instance.
SRE Bot: FYI — add alert: gpu_temp_c > 85 for 2m AND gpu_sm_occupancy_pct > 95% -> Severity 2.
PerfBot: Noted. Also flagged a kernel-selector regression in run: kernel_variant fallback increased 12% vs baseline for long sequences.
Mia: Good catch. We'll add a bust test in the rollout: if kernel-fallback-rate > 10% on a route, auto-disable micro_profile for that route and notify #eng-runtime.
Olivia: Can we get a small sample panel for KV cache hits vs misses per token? that'd help correlate tail.
Mia: Yes — telemetry will annotate tokens with kv_hit=true/false. Emit counters: kv_hit_tokens, kv_miss_tokens per route.
Raj: Any concerns about PII in traces? we must scrub prompt text before persisting.
Mia: Absolutely — prompts are hashed client-side and we only persist token timing + hashed prompt id + token index. No raw text stored.
Alex: I'll put initial dashboard draft in https://grafana.redwood/d/telemetry/gpu-microprofiling and share a snapshot.
Olivia: Thx. timeline?
Mia: Staggered rollout: QA tomorrow, opt-in alpha to 5 routes on Thu, wider opt-in next week. Will post canary metrics to #eng-runtime when live. :rocket:
Raj: 👍
PerfBot: Canary baseline created: run id 2026-03-14-canary-001
Mia: If you want early access to enable for a route, ping me or add yourself to the feature flag in the route config.
